title: Layout with many fonts
description: Layout-quality rule — the text objects of a layout show more fonts than the threshold (default 3). Every font counts: the base font of each object, formatted text runs with a font of their own and the text areas of charts; the default font of the file (theme names no font) does not count as a font. Many fonts on one layout usually mean styling object by object instead of through the theme.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A layout reads calm with one or two fonts. Each further font is mostly a local override that a theme change does not touch, and on platforms without the font FileMaker substitutes another one.
rule.remediation: Move the fonts into the theme or into named styles and remove the local font settings; keep a second font only where it carries meaning (headings, monospace values).
